name: wow-addon-workspace
description: Claude Code plugins for writing and maintaining World of Warcraft addons, and workflow guardrails that work on any project.

plugins.name: wow-addon-dev
plugins.description: A WoW addon workspace for Claude Code: declare your addons, create new ones from a template, check them before a commit (Lua 5.1 syntax, .toc, size, translations, headless tests), see after a patch what changed in Blizzard's UI code and where your addons use it, and give Claude the API facts measured on WoW: Forever plus agents that look APIs up and review a diff for known traps.

plugins.name: dev-workflow-core
plugins.description: Workflow guardrails for any project, driven by a .claude/dev-workflow.json (without it, nothing happens): the project's checks run before Claude hands back and a failure stops it from concluding, a size guard on files and functions after every write, a block on writes to read-only paths, a warning before editing a file that changed on origin. Plus skills for writing a feature spec and getting a person to check what Claude can't see, and agents that find what a diff made wrong in the docs and where the docs contradict each other.
